subject.title: fix(discord): bound webhook send body reads

question: Should Discord webhook sends share the REST client's fixed 15-second wall-clock budget even when an existing webhook response would otherwise complete after that deadline?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility change to a non-idempotent outbound delivery path; code review cannot determine the product tolerance for abandoning slow sends.

options.title: Accept the shared 15-second boundary
options.body: Merge after exact-head proof confirms the timeout, proxy, activity, and identity paths, accepting bounded failure instead of an indefinitely retained send.

options.title: Keep webhook timing independent
options.body: Do not merge this behavior change until Discord owners define a webhook-specific delivery or retry contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared 15-second boundary
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head proof confirms the timeout, proxy, activity, and identity paths, accepting bounded failure instead of an indefinitely retained send.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the recent adjacent owner of the proposed timeout and loopback-proof work, although repository ownership evidence is limited.
